case_title: M.B. Suresh v. State of Karnataka
high_court_outcome: Convicted under s. 302 and 427, IPC and s. 27 of the Arms Act
offence_finally_established: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder
neutral_facts: The accused shot at the victim, who was killed after sustaining injuries while being taken to the hospital. The victim was accompanied by others who took him to the village, but he died on the way. The post-mortem examination revealed multiple injuries caused by the accused, but the doctor opined that the cause of death was due to shock. The prosecution argued that the injuries sustained by the victim were sufficient to cause shock, leading to his death. However, the evidence did not conclusively establish that the injuries caused by the accused were the direct cause of the victim's death.
